units.note: frozen model-free on the 937-example static memory; the outer folds (k 5, seed 0, compile fraction 0.25) are the incumbent evaluation's; injection and access_control equal exp-002's 160 units

kind: rule: one zero-cost scoring pass of the six slice-2 incumbent programs; arms differ only in the BLOCK rule
zero_cost: responses replayed from the response cache only, behind a meter with zero USD and call ceilings around a refusing client; a unit with any uncached response is excluded and counted; the run is void unless the meter reads 0 calls and $0

arms.A: today's rule: Platt map cross-fitted per family; BLOCK only when the calibration check holds (slope CI contains 1, intercept CI contains 0, ECE <= 0.05); BLOCK point nested on the other folds' calibrated p (Wilson LB >= 0.95)
arms.B: selective blocking: per family and outer fold, threshold chosen on the family's paired units in the other four folds as the lowest raw score t with Wilson 95% LB of flagged precision >= 0.95 (unsure verdicts never flag); none -> no BLOCK on that fold
arms.C: secondary, non-deciding: as B with point precision >= 0.95 over at least 10 training flags

primary_metric: held-out (outer-fold) Wilson 95% lower bound of flagged precision, per family, arm B, paired population

populations.primary: paired (both sides of the candidate present; excludes every positives-only group and any unpaired unit)

secondary_metrics: repository-cluster bootstrap 95% CI of flagged precision
decision_rule: REJECT B if in any family B flags held-out paired units at a point precision < 0.95; else ADOPT B if in some family B's held-out paired Wilson LB >= 0.95; else INCONCLUSIVE (the incumbent rule stays)
m4_reading: a family reaches the M4 precision bar on held-out repositories when its held-out paired Wilson LB >= 0.95; point precision reported beside it
power: a Wilson LB of 0.95 needs >= 73 flagged units with no false flag; the largest family holds 38 paired positives over all five folds, so arm B cannot offer a BLOCK in any family by construction; expected verdict inconclusive
